verdict.rationale: npm is a package manager and registry, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in servers to use their tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows npm shipping any MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply; its documented features are installing, publishing, searching packages and configuring registries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
